gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-inika: Oldtimer stamps out round, parenthesis-like forms with no calligraphic swell, every stroke held to one measured thickness, a commanding display voice. Inika's traditional text serif unfolds gently across paragraphs, each s see-through.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-kay-pho-du: Kay Pho Du breathes through hollow, reed-like counters and a rolling-ball pen's single-width trail, giving the text a traditional footing. Oldtimer's round parenthesis shapes, free of any swell, are the standout.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-nunito-sans: Round, commanding, and free of calligraphic thinning: that's Oldtimer up top. Below, Nunito Sans is a soft sans with open-mouthed curves, so paragraphs glide along gently and without any fuss.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-amulya: Origami paints single-stroke letters at constant width, like poured lead type. Amulya, with moderate lowercase height and generous curves, gives that tall, dense heading room to stand out.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-plein: Unique and contemporary, Origami has a single-stroke brush look at constant width. Plein stays reliable beneath it, with a clear channel leading into each round letter and a moderate lowercase height.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-almendra: Single-stroke brush lettering with horizontal bars matching the stems: that is Origami, a thoroughly unmistakable display opener. Origami grabs attention while Almendra's deep, bookish lowercase does the quiet reading.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-quando: Synthwave authority in a constant-width outline: Outrun Future spaces its letters wide. Quando, a bookish serif, shares that wide spacing, and the shared looseness is what ties the two together.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-familjen-grotes: Over There looks drawn with a fixed-width nib, vintage-military and commanding, with generous white space between glyphs. Familjen Grotesk, lively and tall in the lowercase, gives that wiry heading an easygoing partner.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-hind: Stern, spaced-out, and vintage-military: Over There looks drawn by a fixed-width nib. While Over There commands attention, Hind quietly does the reading with steady strokes and lowercase nearly matching its capitals.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-nunito: Nunito brings big round bowls and terminals that finish away from the stem, approachable and contemporary. Nunito carries the reading gently beneath Over There's stern, vintage-military heading, keeping paragraphs friendly.
